name: Mihályfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mihályfa: a crowned blue shield with an archangel, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed MIHÁLYFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mihályfa arms with crown, helm, crest, mantling and scroll
